title: Dap ur Homies (unofficially neoforged)
description: You can now DAP ur Homies! YEET them Catch them and more Coop Features
body:
[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/1Ls2pii3?logo=modrinth&style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/dap-ur-homies-unofficially-neoforged) [![CurseForge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1597240?logo=curseforge&style=for-the-badge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dap-ur-homies-unofficially-neoforged)

Unofficial Neoforge port for the [Dap ur Homies mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dap-ur-homies). 

The original Dap ur Homies mod required [Forgified Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/forgified-fabric-api) and [Syntra Connector](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sinytra-connector) to run in NeoForge. 

This version of the mod runs natively on Neoforge and only requires [Player Animation Library](https://modrinth.com/mod/player-animation-library).

Keybinds can be changed in settings. 

Includes all features of the original Dap ur Homies mod: 
- Charged dap with `G`  
- Dap timing tiers  
- Dap combo chain  
- Dap hold/group dap  
- Face-to-face / normal dap  
- Fire dap combo using `J`  
- High five with `H`  
- High five combo/hug/QTE hug  
- Huddle  
- Grab players with `R`  
- Throw grabbed players with `T`  
- Human shield mode with `V`  
- Spin/helicopter-style grab  
- Ground pound  
- Push interaction  
- Fall catch  
- Fall dap  
- Squash animation  
- Mario jump off another player  
- Kick/drop kick  
- Clap  
- Hug with `F`  
- Sit mechanic with `/sit`  
- Mahito (potion effect)  
- First-person animation support  
- Custom sounds  
- Custom player animations through Player Animation Library  
- Config file: `config/coopmoves.json`

If you encounter any bugs, please report them on the mod's GitHub page.
